name: – Sabrina Repp – After § 35 – Am 7
title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU Youth Strategy 2019-2027
part_text: 35a. Urges that the proposed directive of the European Parliament and of the Council on improving and enforcing working conditions of trainees and combating regular employment relationships disguised as traineeships, be as ambitious as possible; calls for the scope of this directive to be broad enough to ensure that the rights of trainees, particularly those relating to remuneration and the possibility of terminating the traineeship without prejudice in the event of a breach of fundamental rights, can be fully defended by this directive; hopes that the negotiations will be concluded as quickly as possible.
